modulePaths.name: Module paths
modulePaths.description: DccObject paths whose visible/disable configuration is initialized at startup. The root list contains control-center groups and is merged with each plugin's list from same-name metadata under its plugin-name subpath; plugins without subpath metadata fall back to the root list.
modulePaths.description[zh_CN]: 启动时初始化 visible/disable 配置的 DccObject 路径。根清单包含控制中心自身的分组，并与各插件以插件名为 subpath 的同名元数据清单合并；未提供子路径元数据的插件回退到根清单。
